summary: Delta Water missed another promised payment date; finance moved expected collection to late October.
Alba procurement requested final commercial terms; opportunity remains on track for September close.
OptiVision confirmed an additional 9-day delay on critical machine-vision components for P003.
NovaGlass escalated concerns about delivery slippage on P005 to the account director.
Aurea Metals completed technical validation and requested procurement onboarding documentation.
Operations logged additional engineering work requested by Orion; commercial approval remains unresolved.
Helios paid €80k against overdue invoice I001 but left €100k outstanding pending change-order discussion.
P001 forecast margin reduced from 27% to 24% after updated drive pricing and overtime forecast.
Orion Plant 2 close date moved for the fourth time; CRM probability remains at 75%.
Alba MES project reported a four-day schedule slip with no material margin impact.
VerdeChem paid invoice I008 before due date.
Delta Water retrofit recorded another rework incident, adding €6k estimated cost.
NovaGlass scope change remains unbilled while delivery team continues implementation.
OptiVision announced an 11% year-on-year component price increase for Q4 deliveries.
Treasury forecast indicates cash could fall below €500k within six weeks without improved collections.
